releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes: ## What's new in 0.2.0 This release hardens the research protocol and ships the evaluation work that came out of comparing this skill against other deep-research skills. ### Sources you cannot open are now handled by rule The strongest primary sources are often behind a paywall or a bot wall. Until now, the right response — record the failure, note the gap, and never pass a snippet off as the original — was implied but not written down. It now is: a blocked page is logged as an observation with its HTTP status, the gap goes into the report as an availability caveat, and a claim whose only support is an unreachable source is labelled `unknown` instead of quietly softened. ### The validator tells you how to fix a failure A failed run used to get a code and a location. releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes: Two versions of work are rolled up here (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0). ## Better agent discovery and chain safety - New `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`: a read-only, zero-dependency CLI that lists your custom agents (slim and native sources) and flags risky fallback chains — duplicate model ids, chains outside 2–4 entries, non-Go fallback ids not confirmed in the local registry, and vision lanes whose model is not marked vision-verified. It prints compact JSON instead of making you read config files by hand. - New `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`: a compact digest of the cached model snapshot (~97% shorter than the raw file), with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`. ## Clearer recommendations - The recommendation table now includes a **role overview** column: a one-line, plain-language description of wha…

en.headline: sogeisetsu ships meld-deepresearch v0.2.0 and opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0
en.summary: On 2026-10-04, sogeisetsu logged 32 commits across three repositories, with no pull requests, issues, or reviews. In sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch, 15 own commits hardened the research skill: SKILL.md now lists genre templates and marks stop points, the improvement plan landed (renderer, merge, validator, gaps, genres, docs), a SenseNova capability gap analysis was added, access-blocked handling was made explicit with validator hints and same-publisher origin warnings, mid-run budget uplift was allowed, and the site/pages received layout and copy fixes ahead of the 0.2.0 release prep. In sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu, 15 own commits plus 9 automated commits by github-actions[bot] fixed AI summary truncation (max_tokens counting CoT) and daily-report AI summary failures (model-parse fallback, JSON retry, no-skip on missing AI), added AGENTS.md and scripts/daily/verify.mjs, switched titles to Chomsky/Newsreader with a Chinese serif pairing and a new favicon, changed summary rendering to one paragraph per sentence, and moved commit counting to commit-date with own/automated split and merge commits excluded. In sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker, 2 own commits added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts and documented vision verification, the Windows refresh path, and the role-overview column. Two releases shipped: meld-deepresearch v0.2.0 and opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0.

releaseNotes.summary: Hardens the research protocol with explicit handling for paywalled or bot-walled sources: blocked pages are logged with HTTP status, gaps become availability caveats, and claims resting only on unreachable sources are labelled unknown. The validator now returns a fix hint alongside the failure code and location, and the release ships the evaluation work from comparing this skill against other deep-research skills.

Rolls up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 with new scripts/discover-agents.mjs (read-only CLI that lists custom agents and flags risky fallback chains) and scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs (a ~97% shorter digest of the cached model snapshot with --ids, --trait, and --json). The recommendation table gains a role overview column with a plain-language description of each role.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 发布 meld-deepresearch v0.2.0 与 opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-04，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共提交 32 次，无 PR、issue 或 review。在 sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch 中，15 次本人提交加固了研究 skill：SKILL.md 列出 genre 模板并标注停止点，改进计划落地（renderer、merge、validator、gaps、genres、docs），新增 SenseNova 能力差距分析，明确 access-blocked 处理并加入 validator 提示与同出版方来源告警，允许运行中预算上调，同时修复了站点与页面的布局与文案，为 0.2.0 发布做准备。在 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 中，15 次本人提交，另有 9 次由 github-actions[bot] 自动提交：修复了 AI 摘要截断（根因是 max_tokens 计入 CoT 导致 content 恒为空）与日报 AI 摘要失败（模型解析回退、JSON 重试、缺 AI 不再跳过），新增 AGENTS.md 与 scripts/daily/verify.mjs，标题改用 Chomsky/Newsreader 并搭配中文宋体、新增 favicon，摘要改为每句一段，提交统计改为按 commit date 且区分本人/机器人、排除合并提交。在 sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker 中，2 次本人提交新增 agent-discovery 与 snapshot-summary 脚本，并记录 vision 验证、Windows 刷新路径与 role-overview 列。当日发布两个版本：meld-deepresearch v0.2.0 与 opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0。

releaseNotes.summary: 加固研究协议，明确处理付费墙或反爬墙来源：被拦截页面按 HTTP 状态记录，缺口作为可用性说明写入报告，仅依赖不可达来源的结论标记为 unknown。validator 现在除返回失败码与位置外，还会给出修复提示；本次发布同时收录了与其他 deep-research skill 对比得出的评估工作。
合并 v1.2.0 与 v1.3.0 的工作，新增 scripts/discover-agents.mjs（只读、零依赖 CLI，列出自定义 agent 并标记风险回退链）与 scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs（缓存模型快照的约 97% 精简摘要，支持 --ids、--trait、--json）。推荐表新增 role overview 列，用一句白话描述每个角色。
